verdict.rationale: Vast.ai offers a CLI, Python SDK, and REST API with programmatic control over the whole platform, plus filtered offer search that returns many results. A user could script loops over many instances, volumes, or endpoints. The evidence never shows a native bulk or batch operation that acts on many items in one command. missing for 10: documented multi-item or batch commands (e.g., destroy/stop/label many instances at once), bulk API endpoints, any examples of bulk workflows, independent corroboration.
